description: Offline content pins for the installed, tested Windows x86-64 toolchain. No dependency files are redistributed by this manifest.

scope.source_content: Entire Coalton and installed Quicklisp release trees; Quicklisp bootstrap/client sources; selected distribution indices.
scope.sbcl_content: Installed executable, core, and contrib binaries.
scope.limits: No cached FASLs outside the SBCL install are certified. Fresh runtime metadata is required to check ASDF source resolution. This is an installed-content pin, not a downloader or a promise of bit-identical output across machines.
